<?xdl version="0.5.0" ?><Synthesis>

  <Hardware>
    <Component id="cartridge_mgso4" type="cartridge" chemical="mgso4"/>
    <Component id="reactor" type="reactor"/>
    <Component id="rotavap" type="rotavap"/>
    <Component id="separator" type="separator"/>
  </Hardware>

  <Reagents>
    <Reagent name="1,2-diphenylethanone o-acetyloxime" role="reagent"/>
    <Reagent name="dmf" role="reagent"/>
    <Reagent name="cs2co3" role="reagent"/>
    <Reagent name="water" role="reagent"/>
    <Reagent name="10% etoac/hexane" role="reagent"/>
    <Reagent name="aq. nacl" role="reagent"/>
  </Reagents>

  <Procedure>
    <AddSolid vessel="reactor" reagent="1,2-diphenylethanone o-acetyloxime" mass="4.22 g"/>

    <AddSolid vessel="reactor" reagent="cs2co3" mass="7.82 g"/>

    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="dmf" volume="50 mL"/>

    <EvacuateAndRefill vessel="reactor" repeats="3"/>

    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="80" time="1 h" stir="True"/>

    <HeatChillToTemp vessel="reactor" temp="25" active="False" continue_heatchill="False"/>

    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="water" volume="100 mL"/>

    <Separate purpose="extract" from_vessel="reactor" separation_vessel="separator" to_vessel="separator" product_phase="top" solvent="10% etoac/hexane" solvent_volume="50 mL" repeats="3"/>

    <Separate purpose="wash" from_vessel="separator" separation_vessel="separator" to_vessel="separator" product_phase="top" solvent="water" solvent_volume="50 mL" repeats="2"/>

    <Separate purpose="wash" from_vessel="separator" separation_vessel="separator" to_vessel="rotavap" through="mgso4" product_phase="top" solvent="aq. nacl" solvent_volume="50 mL" repeats="2"/>

    <Evaporate vessel="rotavap" temp="40 °C" pressure="50 mbar" time="60 min" mode="auto"/>
  </Procedure>

</Synthesis>

<?xdl version="0.5.0" ?>

<Synthesis>

  <Hardware>
    <Component
      id="cartridge_silica"
      type="cartridge"
      chemical="silica" />
    <Component
      id="reactor1"
      type="reactor" />
    <Component
      id="reactor2"
      type="reactor" />
    <Component
      id="rotavap"
      type="rotavap" />
  </Hardware>

  <Reagents>
    <Reagent
      name="ni(oac)2-4h2o"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="bphen"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="pyridinium salt"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="4-acetylphenyl boronic acid"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="kot-bu"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="dioxane"
      role="reagent" />
    <Reagent
      name="ethanol"
      role="solvent" />
    <Reagent
      name="etoac"
      role="solvent" />
  </Reagents>

  <Procedure>
    <!-- 10 mol% -->
    <AddSolid
      vessel='reactor1'
      reagent='ni(oac)2-4h2o'
      mass='250 mg'
    />

    <!-- 24 mol% -->
    <AddSolid
      vessel='reactor1'
      reagent='bphen'
      mass='800 mg'
    />

    <EvacuateAndRefill
      vessel='reactor1'
      repeats='3'
    />

    <!-- 1.0 eq. 10 mmol -->
    <AddSolid
      vessel='reactor2'
      reagent='pyridinium salt'
      mass='4.77 g'
    />

    <!-- 3.0 eq. 30 mmol MW = 164  -->
    <AddSolid
      vessel='reactor2'
      reagent='4-acetylphenyl boronic acid'
      mass='4.92 g'
    />

    <!-- 3.4 eq. 34 mmol  -->
    <AddSolid
      vessel='reactor2'
      reagent='kot-bu'
      mass='3.82 g'
    />

    <EvacuateAndRefill
      vessel='reactor2'
      repeats='3'
    />

    <Add
      vessel='reactor1'
      reagent='dioxane'
      volume='25 mL'
      stir='True'
    />

    <Add
      vessel='reactor2'
      reagent='dioxane'
      volume='25 mL'
      stir='True'
    />

    <Add
      vessel='reactor2'
      reagent='ethanol'
      volume='2.9 mL'
      stir='True'
    />

    <Async>
      <Stir
        vessel='reactor1'
        time='1 h'
        speed='600'
      />
    </Async>

    <Stir
      vessel='reactor2'
      time='1 h'
      speed='600'
    />

    <Transfer
      from_vessel='reactor1'
      to_vessel='reactor2'
      volume='all'
      rinsing_solvent='dioxane'
      rinsing_volume='25'
      rinsing_repeats='2'
    />

    <HeatChill
      vessel='reactor2'
      temp='60'
      time='24 h'
      stir='True'
    />

    <HeatChillToTemp
      vessel='reactor2'
      temp='25'
      active='False'
      continue_heatchill='False'
    />

    <Repeat repeats='4'>
      <Add
        vessel='reactor2'
        reagent='etoac'
        volume='50 mL'
        stir='True'
      />
      <StopStir
        vessel='reactor2'
      />
      <Transfer
        from_vessel='reactor2'
        to_vessel='rotavap'
        through='silica'
        volume='all'
      />
    </Repeat>

    <Evaporate
      vessel='rotavap'
      temp='40'
      mode='auto'
    />
  </Procedure>

</Synthesis>
